name: Token offering

subjectOf.text: The balance between the commercial benefits and use cases attached to a token and the scarcity of its supply is critical in the issuance of a token offering.
subjectOf.abstract: The balance of commercial benefits of a token offering and associated use cases of the token in combination with supply scarcity is critical in the issuance of a token offering.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

subjectOf.text: CRDAO code review insurance is funded from the CRDAO Code Review Pool, which consists of the assets raised during the CRDAO token offering plus ten percent of any incoming code review job revenue.
subjectOf.abstract: The insurance will be paid from the CRDAO Code Review Pool (CRP) which consists of the assets raised during the CRDAO token offering as well as 10% of any incoming code review job revenue.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: future iterations of the CRDAO with a token offering completed
